dataset_claim: SCORPION was inspected repeatedly in RT1-RT3; RT4 is post-hoc mechanism-intervention development, NOT external confirmation
motivation: RT3 exact replay and paired-gallery collision audit showed isotropic versus residual-tangent: fold global top1 -0.102431 CI[-0.117361,-0.088194]; cross-slide-only errors +0.060417 CI[0.046875,0.073611]; size-matched nine-negative retrieval -0.027143 CI[-0.031245,-0.023090], crossslide margin -0.037438 CI[-0.042966,-0.031980], withinslide margin -0.036098 CI[-0.045601,-0.027060]. These support identity crowding, but not its cause or any clinical-biology claim.

input_binding.split: unchanged RT1 semantic slide partition, train/val/test

design.models: exact RT1 architecture (encoder 32→64→8, decoder 8→64→32, scanner operators); all 9640 trainable parameters
design.heldout_operator_calibration: unchanged RT1 on val slides, isolated heldout operator
design.evaluation: unchanged RT1 slide metrics plus whole-heldout-fold same-region cosine top1 and true vs hardest within/cross slide margins

optimization.base_objective: identical RT3 objective with no-inverse control and isotropic/residual smoothing; 160 epochs, AdamW lr 0.001 wd 0.0001; unchanged RT1 weights and latent variance floor
optimization.isotropic_directions: exact original RT3 fixed seed 2026100603, matching residual RMS; no retuning
optimization.identity_objective: symmetric cross-entropy InfoNCE: reference E(x_AT2) <-> transported known-scanner E(T_s^-1(x_s)) across ALL distinct TRAIN region rows as negatives; true positive diagonal matched by slide_id+region_id, compared only with other TRAIN regions, all scanners s except AT2 and heldout
optimization.identity_negative_groups: both same-slide and other-slide train regions, no externally labelled biology
optimization.identity_operator_gradients: stop-gradient inverse-transport inputs for identity term; encoder gradients permitted. Base reconstruction/transport losses still update known operators
optimization.reference_anchor: reference E(x_AT2) is not detached: both encoder views receive gradients, operator inputs detached in the contrastive add-on
optimization.denominator: cross-entropy over all unique TRAIN region indices (not slide indices), mean across known nonreference scanners and bidirectional query directions
optimization.tuning_policy: no outcome-driven weight/temperature/margin/seeds tuning; any revision becomes separate experiment and cannot rescue this frozen RT4

statistical_unit.mean: average three seeds per (slide,scanner,arm), then four scanner holdouts per slide
statistical_unit.interval: 95% nonparametric source-slide bootstrap (descriptive on burned SCORPION)

frozen_primary_mechanism_checks: Global heldout-fold top1 retrieval: isotropic_identity minus isotropic_original lower 95% CI > 0
Cross-slide correct-minus-hardest-impostor cosine margin: isotropic_identity minus isotropic_original lower 95% CI > 0
Isotropic identity enhancement does not sacrifice its alignment beyond 0.005 absolute MSE: upper 95% CI(isotropic_identity minus isotropic_original alignment MSE) < +0.005
Isotropic_identity vs no_inverse_control fold-global retrieval noninferior, lower CI > -0.02
Isotropic_identity alignment improved over no_inverse_control: lower 95% CI(control minus isotropic_identity alignment MSE) > 0
Isotropic_identity scanner-probe accuracy lower than no_inverse_control: lower 95% CI(control minus isotropic_identity known-scanner probe) > 0
All arms capacity-identical; heldout operators matched across arms within fold/scanner/seed (1e-7 absolute state tolerance), operator roundtrip below 1e-8
secondary_interactions: Identity term marginal gain on residual family global retrieval and crossslide cosine margins
Difference-in-differences of identity contribution: (iso+id - iso) - (res+id - res) on global retrieval
Test-tissue cosine margin within slide, size-matched cross-slide nine-negative top1, cross-slide-only error
Within-slide top1, reference reconstruction, acquisition leakage after train standardization, effective rank
Per-scanner, per-fold, per-slide heterogeneity and training loss trajectories
Compare all four 2x2 cells, not only highest scoring arm

decision_tree.all_primary_checks_pass: Identity-anchor causally repairs this defined isotropic failure on burned SCORPION; still development-only, not architecture promotion
decision_tree.identity_improves_retrieval_but_hurts_al: Pareto tradeoff; identity protection not a simultaneous invariance repair
decision_tree.identity_improves_isotropic_but_not_tang: Counteracts generic over-smoothing, not general identity advantage
decision_tree.no_retrieval_margin_improvement: Identity-crowding audit was descriptive but this defined intervention does not repair it

required_beyond_scorpion: Freeze any ensuing model on genuinely unseen scanner-paired physical slides and independent biological task labels, patient/specimen hierarchy where available, fair ComBat/FEATMAP/centroid/Procrustes/PA-NF comparators, no post outcome retuning
anti_claims: PA-NF superiority solely from development results
